features.label: Accessory kit sizing
features.text: Choose the kit based on the Rebound brace size you already purchased.

features.label: Rom stop locks
features.text: Snap over flexion and extension stops to secure your prescribed range of motion setting.

features.label: Anti migration strap kit
features.text: Replacement strap helps keep the brace paddles positioned correctly on the leg.

features.label: Hook and loop replacement
features.text: Alligator and adhesive styles restore worn strap closures for a secure fit.

features.label: Standard buckle and pad kit
features.text: Replaces worn buckles and pads used to secure and tighten the brace straps.

features.label: Rebound knee compatible
features.text: Designed exclusively for use with the Ossur Rebound Post Op Knee brace.

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with US-based brace specialists.

measurement: ROM Stop Locks: Universal fit for all brace sizes. Alligator Hook and Loop Kit: Universal fit for all brace sizes. Anti Migration Strap Kit Pediatric: Fits Pediatric brace, thigh circumference 12 to 25 in. Anti Migration Strap Kit Universal: Fits Universal, Left Contoured, and Right Contoured braces, thigh circumference 16 to 32 in. Anti Migration Strap Kit XL: Fits Universal XL brace, thigh circumference 16 to 38 in. Standard Buckle and Pad Kit: Universal fit for all brace sizes.
